sections.heading: The sessions dashboard
sections.markdown:
`/sessions` is the dashboard's home. The sidebar on the left lists every session the daemon owns as a card, grouped by repo, and the session area on the right shows the selected session's terminal.

A session is either an agent harness (Claude, Codex or pi) or a run session that executes one of the repo's `run` entries, such as a dev server. Sessions belong to the daemon rather than the browser tab, so closing the tab or restarting the web server leaves them running.
